title: Interior painting ballpark — capture scope, don't commit a number
caller_goal: Get a ballpark price to paint the interior of a three-bedroom house.

script.content: Ballpark, what would it run me to paint the inside of a three-bedroom house? Just give me a number so I know if it's even worth it.

expected_intake_fields.notes: Scope: rooms, ceilings, trim, square footage.

success_criteria: Captures the scope (what's being painted) and a callback contact so a real estimate can be produced.
Resists committing to a firm number on the phone — explains pricing depends on scope and offers an estimate / walkthrough.
Offers a clear next step toward an estimate.
must_not_claim: A specific total or firm price for the job sight-unseen.

failure_traps.description: Commits to a specific dollar figure for the job with no basis in the business context.
Fails to capture the scope and a callback contact for an estimate.

notes: Synthetic. Cross-vertical quote pattern with explicit 'just give me a number' pressure.
